# Feature: Timed Turn Defense Clock + Input-Lock Freeze

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-02 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
In **Zeit** matches, the 60s per-turn clock must follow who must act now (`findActingPlayer`), giving defenders a fresh budget when a block/reaction window opens. Presentation/input locks freeze both match and turn clocks (same as soft pause). Force-skip during defense only clears the interrupt — it must not end the attacker’s remaining main turn.

## Preconditions
- Zeit-Match armed (header timers docked)
- Combat can open with defender ≠ `activePlayer`
- Presentation queue can lock input during combat resolve / damage

## Happy Path
- [ ] Turn clock owner = acting player (defender during combat / pending interrupt), else `activePlayer`
- [ ] Header label „Du“ / „Gegner“ reflects clock owner (not only active seat)
- [ ] Entering a defense/reaction window resets turn remaining to 60s
- [ ] Leaving the window (combat cleared) switches clock owner back and resets budget for the new owner
- [ ] Soft pause **or** `isInputLocked` freezes turn + match countdown; resume when both clear
- [ ] Turn expiry during defense applies `PASS_BLOCK` / reaction passes only, then stops with attacker still active
- [ ] Turn expiry on main turn still force-skips until `activePlayer` flips

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Late bot attack with ≤ few seconds left still grants human full 60s to block
- [ ] Force-skip while input-locked does not fire (clock frozen)
- [ ] Formula DnD of Technik/Katalysator with active Elementarladung shows same `window.confirm` as preview path

## Regression
- [ ] Soft pause amber UI still driven by AppNav `matchPaused`
- [ ] Standard (non-Zeit) matches ignore turn clock
- [ ] `npm run checks` green

## Assumptions
- Fresh 60s on every clock-owner change (including returning to attacker after defense) is acceptable YAGNI vs saving attacker remainder
- Match clock uses the same pause-accounting meta path when input-locked (no separate amber “Pause” chrome)
